description: This file defines structures and classes related to OFDM demodulation, including configuration parameters, symbol and slot demodulators, and their interfaces for demodulating OFDM signals at symbol and slot granularity.

classes.name: ofdm_demodulator_configuration
classes.description: Structure holding configuration parameters for OFDM demodulation, including numerology, bandwidth, DFT size, cyclic prefix, window offset, scale, and center frequency.

classes.name: ofdm_symbol_demodulator
classes.description: Abstract class defining interface for OFDM symbol-level demodulation, including methods to get symbol size, set center frequency, and perform demodulation.

classes.name: ofdm_slot_demodulator
classes.description: Abstract class defining interface for OFDM slot-level demodulation, including methods to get slot size and perform demodulation.

methods.name: get_symbol_size
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for a given symbol index, including cyclic prefix.

methods.name: set_center_frequency
methods.description: Sets the center frequency for demodulation, thread-safe, effective on next demodulate call.

methods.name: demodulate
methods.description: Performs OFDM demodulation on input signal, outputting frequency domain data to resource_grid_writer.

methods.name: get_slot_size
methods.description: Returns the number of samples for a given slot index, including cyclic prefix.
